decision: Retain the sampled sequence finding: the August 7 local stop contact precedes the first observed adverse liquidation contact by 465.082 seconds, with sufficient nearby visible closing depth. This challenges liquidation-first attribution of the entire 15-minute bar but does not reconstruct an actual fill or revise portfolio PnL. High confidence in measurements, medium in within-bar interpretation, low in revised fill/profitability claims. The full 18-case inventory finds one unique ambiguous accepted noncrypto lifecycle, so next preregister its complete entry-to-exit event replay across every original cost contract.
falsifier: Changed source hashes, contradictory raw normalization or independent arithmetic, denser marks contradicting the observed sequence, or inadequate closing depth. Revised modeled economics require complete entry-to-exit evidence and explicit latency, fees, funding and execution assumptions; the bounded sampled contacts alone are insufficient.
hypothesis: Finer historical SNDK marks and public trade/book timestamps can qualify the two largest cash-open attribution clock drivers and the August 7 modeled stop-versus-liquidation sequence.
limitations: The two dates were selected because they drive prior timing sensitivity on already explored historical data; this is not independent profitability validation.
Price samples have maximum gaps of 3.367 and 3.262 seconds; sampled contacts do not prove continuous event coverage or exact venue trigger times.
Acquisition starts at 13:29 UTC, after the original 11:00 and 13:00 entries; local first contacts are not qualified as first lifecycle contacts.
Depth snapshots precede or follow the sampled marks and do not reconstruct latency, order arrival, queue position or actual client fills.
The August 6 13:30-13:31 trade partition is capped at 10 pages with a continuation cursor after 13:30:55.391; its full-bar OHLC remains unavailable.
Complete participant pagination does not itself establish absence of vendor collection gaps.

Same-millisecond final prints contain different prices. Unique closes remain unresolved; registered closes are among the observed candidates. The intermediate trade-ID-selected close was corrected without modifying the source candle.
The older August 6 book manifest lacks the censor-count field. Raw replay derives zero censored rows and matches the publication; missing metadata was not replaced with an assumed zero.
Original full-fee liquidation thresholds change with entry fees; nominal, adverse and full-fee cases must remain distinct.
All 18 cases reuse one unique ambiguous accepted noncrypto trade among 99 lifecycles per case. No live PnL, strategy, deployment or process lifecycle was changed.
Coverage counts concern the pure threshold module, not all acquisition/archive I/O or the whole project.
The sealed September 8-22 prospective experiment remains unopened.
